title: 人工智能生成合成内容标识办法

policy_extraction.issuing_body: 国家互联网信息办公室、工业和信息化部、公安部、国家广播电视总局

evidence.quote: 人工智能生成合成内容标识包括显式标识和隐式标识
鼓励服务提供者在生成合成内容中添加数字水印等形式的隐式标识
在文本的起始、末尾或者中间适当位置添加文字提示或者通用符号提示等标识
明确提醒公众该内容属于生成合成内容
提供必要的标识功能，并提醒用户主动声明发布内容中是否包含生成合成内容
任何组织和个人不得恶意删除、篡改、伪造、隐匿本办法规定的生成合成内容标识
鼓励服务提供者在生成合成内容中添加数字水印等形式的隐式标识

policy_extraction.implementation_notes: Document mandates explicit and implicit labeling of AI-generated synthetic content. Explicit labels must appear at specific positions in text, audio, image, video, and virtual scenes. Implicit labels (e.g., digital watermarks, file metadata) are encouraged. Distribution platforms must check metadata and apply appropriate labels. Prohibition on malicious removal or falsification of labels. Specific penalties not detailed in the provided text excerpt.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The document primarily frames AI governance around maintaining social public order and protecting citizens' lawful rights through mandatory labeling of AI-generated content. The stated goals are to 'protect citizens, legal persons and other organizations' lawful rights' and 'maintain social public interests,' indicating a social stability and rights protection framing rather than existential risk or economic competition.

evidence_spans.quote: 保护公民、法人和其他组织合法权益，维护社会公共利益
